messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

You can now enter a **Deal name** under “Reproduce a game” before exporting a snapshot. Loading that snapshot restores the name and progress. Unnamed saves continue to use the existing format.

Pasted snapshots now load regardless of the order of their JSON properties, while invalid saves remain rejected.

Verification passed: 142 unit tests, type checking, the production build, and all 79 browser tests. The repository-wide formatting check still reports 13 existing files outside this change; all changed files pass formatting.
